serial.reason: AC30 requires a never-answering broker to be reported not ready between 990 and 1,100 ms of wall-clock time; a timer delayed over 100 ms by parallel files fails it (1,160 ms at concurrency 8).

The HTTP entry timeout case needs the 5,000 ms entry timer to abort the dispatched handler before the 503 reaches the client; under CPU contention from parallel files the handler saw no abort (concurrency 8).
